up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL5726773. Return the molecule's CHEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES, with each distinct molecule listed only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726773';
